systems.system: portail unique des services publics digitalisés
systems.country_label: portail unique (portail central des services publics digitalisés)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Économie Numérique et de la Transformation Digitale (MENTD), strategy lead
systems.tiers: planned in April 2021 as a national single portal for citizens and businesses; requests for birth, marriage and death acts are among its 20 priority services, to be digitalised end to end and tied to a unique identifier per citizen
national; named as supporting the requests for birth, marriage and death acts, nationality certificate, identity card, passport, visa and residence card

note: No fact: the passages are a plan (April 2021) to put the request for and delivery of copies of civil-status acts on a single portal, a certificate service; they say nothing of how or where a birth or death is registered, and name no registrar's system.
